none: PAS KENT-29011C: Roman coin. Nummi AE2 of Constantine II or Constans
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete but drilled for suspension, struck or hammered, copper alloy, Nummi or AE2 of Constantine II (337-361AD) or Constans (337-350AD). Obverse: Pearl diadem, draped narrow bust right. Inscription: [DN](C)ON(ST)[ANS PF AVG] Reverse: The Emperor standing in a galley with a standard (now Christian), holding a phoenix or Victory. Inscription: [FEL](T)EMP REPARATI[O] Mint mark: missing. Die…
